title: Illumina COVIDSeq - Amplify Tagmented Amplicons
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters as prompted above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files with .json extensions, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file with a .py extension to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; consult the support articles for calibration tips.
